admission.justification: Repeated large launch capsules across hundreds of selections can consume unbounded host memory before any answer is made.

applicability: Request-local receipt payload acquisition for bounded document-tree discovery.
conditions: Accepted records fit 1 MiB each and the 16 MiB request budget.
One sentinel byte may be read to detect growth after sizing; it is not an accepted receipt.
Distinct paths are read once and only their chat projections survive through the request.
exclusions: The correcting single-document read and taskless enumeration do not use these tree byte budgets.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_role_document_chats.py › DocumentChatTreeTests::test_a_document_named_many_times_is_read_once (8 and 256 selections), ::test_a_request_reads_and_keeps_no_more_than_its_byte_limits_allow (4 and 16 records); red before the repair: notes/reports/worker/c41a5d77-92e0-4b18-a3d6-140c0a7e0b50/after-evidence-attempt3/red/red-F03.txt

statement: One request for the tree's chats reads each distinct launch record once, keeps of a record only the part an answer is made of, and reads at most 1 MiB of one record and 16 MiB in all; a record beyond a limit is not read and its document is answered as unknown.
